page_title: EMP 0-0 CAG | Empoli v Cagliari 06/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
86' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) receives a yellow card.
86' Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) picks up a yellow card.
84' Davide Nicola has decided to make a change. Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) replaces Matteo Prati.
82' Substitution. Ola Solbakken (Empoli) replaces Sebastiano Esposito.
82' Substitution. Roberto Piccoli leaves the pitch and is replaced by Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari).
79' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
72' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Jose Luis Palomino as he is replaced by Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari).
70' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) replacing Christian Kouame.
65' Here's the change. Junior Sambia leaves the pitch and Tyronne Ebuehi (Empoli) comes on as a substitute.
65' Cagliari failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
64' Junior Sambia (Empoli) executes a nice mid-range free kick. His effort only flies inches wide of the left post. Today is obviously not his lucky day.
61' Jose Luis Palomino (Cagliari) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Federico La Penna had an easy-decision to make.
59' Davide Nicola has decided to substitute Nicolas Viola and he is replaced by Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari).
59' Substitution. Zito Luvumbo will be replaced by Florinel Coman (Cagliari).

59' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Elia Caprile makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
55' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Federico La Penna saw the whole situation.
52' Liam Henderson (Empoli) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
49' Sebastiano Luperto (Cagliari) has tested the patience of referee Federico La Penna and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
49' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) takes the free kick, but it sails wide of the target. The goalkeeper didn't have to react at all.
48' Liam Henderson (Empoli) makes a strong challenge and Federico La Penna blows for a foul.
48' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Federico La Penna blows for a foul. A free kick to Cagliari.
42' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) is caught offside!
41' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
39' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Empoli will take a free kick.
37' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) commits a foul and Federico La Penna immediately signals a free kick. Empoli have a free kick.
30' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
28' Liam Henderson (Empoli) makes a rough challenge and Federico La Penna blows his whistle for a foul. Cagliari win a free kick.
25' The corner is swung in but Empoli can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
22' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Empoli comes to nothing.
21' Liam Henderson (Empoli) bends a great shot in from the edge of the box, but Elia Caprile makes a smart save to deny him. Corner kick. Empoli will have an opportunity.
19' Cagliari can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
13' The resulting set piece from Cagliari is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
13' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
8' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
6' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
4' Rough tackle by Nicolas Viola (Cagliari). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
3' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Cagliari, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
3' Federico La Penna blows his whistle and signals a foul after Saba Goglichidze (Empoli) brought his opponent down.
1' The first half has just begun.
Empoli will kick-off.
Federico La Penna got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
